approved.description: True only when the reviewer pressed Approve. It ends this review, not any other.

round.description: The round this answers. Two verdicts with the same `review` and `round` are the same verdict.

page.description: The page the reviewer was on when they submitted or approved.

kind.description: `general` is a comment on the page as a whole; `pinned` is one about an element on it.

body.description: What the reviewer wrote, trimmed. May hold newlines.

page.description: The page the reviewer was on when they wrote it.

createdAt.description: When it was written, in milliseconds since the epoch.

sentIn.description: The round it went out in: always the round of the verdict it is in.

target.description: As in version 1, except for the picture: `screenshotUrl` is where the server keeps it, and `screenshot`, when present, is a local path the client that printed this verdict saved it to.

id.description: The reviewer, as the server knows them. The same id is the same person.

name.description: What to call them, when the server knows.

author.description: Who wrote the comment, as the server signed them in.

items.description: One comment, sent in this round.

comments.description: The comments sent in this round and no other. Empty on approval.

review.description: The review this answers. A round is a round of this review alone.

title: Gloss verdict, version 2
description: What `gloss wait` prints when it is connected to a server holding many reviews.
